Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love. Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever. 20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it. You in? Keep on reading. As a Content LiveOps Manager , you will build Content LiveOps from (almost) zero: there's limited live-ops cadence and an early playbook, so what you set up becomes the operating rhythm Lingokids ship from here on. There's a lot to unlock too. As we grow into the leading kids' entertainment platform for licensed IPs, every new IP adds another vein of live-ops potential (events, drops, tie-ins) nobody's tapped yet. What you’ll do You’ll own and run a weekly content release cadence: new games, new IPs, new content going live on a predictable schedule. Design, plan and run time-limited events as the program matures, eg: a themed weekend drop with its own promotional treatment, not just a content update. Define what a release needs beyond the content itself: teaser moments, custom or animated icons, countdown treatments, in-app announcements, comms, and work with marketing, engineering and design to build what makes that possible. Soft-launch new content and games, and own the process for how something moves from ready to live. Partner with the Content Experimentation team to test the variables that matter (event length, timing, locking, positioning, packaging) and use the results to improve the next release. Be accountable for whether releases actually land: on schedule, and with a measurable lift in engagement and retention. What you’ll bring Direct experience running a content release cadence, live-ops strategy, or live-events pipeline, done operationally. Comfort with a weekly operating rhythm. Strong cross-functional coordination skills: you'll be pulling in engineering, art, and design capacity shared across a broader team, not a dedicated build team of your own. LiveOps and Performance Data literacy: you can look at a release's performance and know whether it worked, how to iterate, and why. Background in games where "what's live changes constantly" is a normal part of the job. Nice to have. Experience specifically with time-limited or seasonal events (eg: a holiday tie-in, a licensed-IP drop, a themed weekend…) Familiarity with subscription or content platforms for a young or family audience. English is a must: We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English , so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication —especially in asynchronous, long-form formats—is key to collaborating successfully. Life at Lingokids 📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us. 🏡 Remote in Spain & Relocation-Friendly Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid . Not currently in Spain? We’d love to have you here! We actively encourage relocation for those looking to make Spain their new home base. 📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options , giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success. 🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity! 🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better! 💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee , integrating them directly into your payroll. 🩺 Health Insurance : Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple. 💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team. 🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU , we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless. 🎉 Company events : Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites! Passion matters more than perfection Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you! Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

review_candidates.description: MAC RENO-DESIGN-BUILD POSITION: ACCOUNTANT Who We Are MAC Reno-Design-Build is a growing residential and light commercial design-build company operating across MAC Reno-Design-Build, MAC Island Construction, and Coastal Accents Millwork. We build and strengthen community through world-class craftsmanship, trusted partnerships, and a team that is humble, hungry, and smart. Our values of collaboration, curiosity, integrity, and C.A.R.E. — Create A Referable Experience — guide how we work with each other, our clients and trade partners.  The Role We are looking for an analytical, systems-oriented Accountant for a broad, hands-on role covering AP, AR, cash, reconciliations, capital and cost tracking, with progressive responsibility across the full accounting cycle, month-end close, financial reporting and analysis. In our project-based construction environment, you need to understand how transactions affect project costs, cash, the GL, financial reporting and business decisions. The role also supports payroll accounting, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations and labour-to-job-cost posting. This role is well suited to someone who asks questions, investigates discrepancies and looks for better ways of working, ideally while pursuing or considering the CPA designation. Reports To: Controller Location: Hybrid/Remote — Pacific Time Employment: Full-Time Salary Range: $68,000–$78,000 annually  What you'll own Accounts Payable and Vendor Accounting: You review and process vendor invoices using TrailD, ensuring accurate coding, documentation, approvals and accounting-period cut-off. You investigate discrepancies, duplicate invoices, missing approvals and other exceptions, maintain accurate vendor records, process employee expenses and corporate credit cards, and prepare payment batches for review and authorization. Accounts Receivable & Cash You record and apply customer payments, investigate unapplied or incorrectly applied receipts, support AR aging and collections, and reconcile cash and banking transactions. You help ensure cash and customer-account information is accurate, current and properly supported. General Accounting & Month-End You support the full accounting cycle, including general ledger accounting, journal entries, bank, credit-card and balance-sheet reconciliations, prepaids, accruals, capital assets, depreciation and supporting schedules. You investigate reconciling items and root causes, support GST/PST and year-end requirements, and progressively take on greater responsibility for month-end close, reporting and analysis. Systems, Workflow & Business Process Improvement A key part of this role is helping MAC continuously improve how Finance works. You develop a strong understanding of our Finance workflows and systems, identify duplicate entry, manual workarounds, data-quality issues and inefficient processes, and help document, standardize and improve them. You use Excel, data analytics, automation and appropriate AI tools to improve accounting processes. Internal Controls & Financial Integrity You follow established approval and segregation-of-duties requirements, maintain complete supporting documentation and audit trails, and identify unusual transactions, control gaps and recurring process issues.  What Success Looks Like Invoices are captured, coded, and matched accurately; payments are prepared, never released solo. Receipts are applied promptly; AR aging is current; daily cash is visible to the Controller. Reconciliations and accounting schedules are complete and current — no unexplained balances and no surprises at month-end. Practical process improvements, automation, and AI opportunities are identified and implemented — less manual work, duplicate entry, and recurring rework. Segregation of duties and financial controls are followed on every transaction; issues are raised and resolved — not worked around. Technology you will work in Acumatica — ERP and accounting TrailD — AP automation and approvals Buildertrend — project management, job cost and WIP Lumber — labour, payroll and job-cost information Banking portals — cash and deposit management Google Workspace — email, spreadsheets and document management ChatGPT/Claude — AI integration and automation What we are looking for Required At least two years of post-secondary accounting coursework or equivalent accounting education and experience. A completed degree or diploma is preferred but not required. Approximately 2–5 years of progressive accounting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Sound accounting fundamentals, including accrual accounting, GL coding, cut-off, journal entries and reconciliations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes and follow issues through to resolution. Process-improvement mindset with an interest in end-to-end accounting workflows, identifying inefficiencies, duplicate entry and control gaps. Interest or experience in data analytics, reporting, automation, AI or emerging technologies to improve Finance processes and efficiency. Strong Excel skills and ability to analyze financial and operational data. Assets Construction, project accounting, job costing or capital-cost tracking experience. Experience with Acumatica or a similar ERP. Character Humble, hungry, and smart — the MAC standard for every team member. Think critically and ask questions when something doesn't make sense. Seek to understand the entire accounting workflow, not simply your individual task. Embrace technology, data analytics, automation, AI and finding better ways of working. Why MAC Genuine growth path: Accountant → Senior Accountant → Controller. A growing multi-entity company with real accounting complexity. A culture built on integrity, collaboration and doing the right thing. A small Finance team where your contributions are visible, and development is a priority. Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada on a permanent basis. MAC cannot provide sponsorship or support for work permits. Intellectual agility and ability to simplify and clearly communicate complex concepts. Proficiency with data analysis, manipulation, interpretation, and reporting. Strong quantitative aptitude, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills. High attention to detail and organizational skills. History of partnering with various levels of leadership across complex organizations, and ability to work cross-collaboratively in a highly matrixed organization. Strong verbal, written and presentation communication skills. Microsoft Office suite (including Excel) and applicable software programs proficiency, and ability to learn/navigate new software programs. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading in a cross-functional, highly matrixed organization, preferably within a managed care organization supporting Medicaid, Medicare, and/or Marketplace programs. History of excelling in roles impacting quality. Advanced knowledge/experience related to National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), Healthcare Effectiveness Data Information Set (HEDIS), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and state-specific regulatory submission requirements.
